title: Chat picker
description: Dropdown picker in the workbench Chat view's input toolbars: icon + label (agent mode, session target, permissions, …). Its module also defines `ds.chatPickers`, the data every Agents window picker opens: harnesses (Copilot, Claude, Codex), environments, recent workspaces, isolation, branches, Copilot modes (Interactive, Plan, Autopilot) and permission levels (Manual, Assisted, Allow all), Claude and Codex approval modes, and each harness's models with effort, context size, speed and pricing, captured from the signed-in product. Helpers: `ds.chatPickers.models(harness)`, `.model(id, harness)`, `.summary(model)` ("Medium · 272K"), `.openList(kind, anchor, current, onPick)`.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: mode = agent picker, target = session target picker

attributes.description: Codicon id (use the -compact variants: agent-compact, vm-compact, shield-compact)
